required.quote: The board shall issue a license to engage in the practice of professional nursing to any applicant who: (a) Submits an application containing the information the board may prescribe; (b) Submits proof satisfactory to the board ... that the applicant has completed a professional nursing educational program ... (c) Passes an examination ... (d) Pays the required fee.

experience_source.quote: The board shall issue a license to engage in the practice of professional nursing to any applicant who: (a) Submits an application containing the information the board may prescribe; (b) Submits proof satisfactory to the board ... that the applicant has completed a professional nursing educational program ... (c) Passes an examination ... (d) Pays the required fee.

exams.name: Board-approved written examination
exams.notes: Required for all nurse applicants unless eligible for licensure by endorsement. At least two examinations held annually for practical and professional nurses.
exams.quote: All nurse applicants, unless eligible for licensure by endorsement, shall be required to pass a written examination approved or prepared by the board, relating to the knowledge, skills, and judgments as incorporated in their respective approved education programs.

required.quote: the board is authorized to require no more than twenty hours of continuing education every two years as a condition of renewal of licenses

hours_per_period.quote: the board is authorized to require no more than twenty hours of continuing education every two years as a condition of renewal of licenses

period_years.quote: the board is authorized to require no more than twenty hours of continuing education every two years as a condition of renewal of licenses

available.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to engage in the practice of professional nursing in this state to a nurse who satisfies the requirements of the occupational credential portability program.

requirements.value: Must satisfy the requirements of the occupational credential portability program, which requires proof of substantially equivalent credentials or holding a current and valid license in good standing for at least one year in a jurisdiction with substantially similar scope of practice.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to engage in the practice of professional nursing in this state to a nurse who satisfies the requirements of the occupational credential portability program.

exists.quote: "Board" means the state board of nursing created in section 12-255-105.

national_certification.value: Nationally recognized accrediting agency (for APRN national certification)
national_certification.quote: a registered professional nurse shall obtain national certification from a nationally recognized accrediting agency, as defined by the board by rule, in the appropriate role and population focus in order to be included in the advanced practice registry

national_association.quote: the applicant has obtained and maintains in good standing a midwife certification from the American Midwifery Certification Board or its successor entity

title_protection.quote: only a person who holds a license to practice professional nursing in this state pursuant to this part 1 or who holds a license in another state and is practicing in this state pursuant to section 24-60-3802 may use the title "registered nurse" and its abbreviation, "R.N."

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife unless licensed to practice that profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license by fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, misleading omission, or material misstatement of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has procured or attempted to procure a license by fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, misleading omission, or material misstatement of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of this part 1
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of this part 1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has acted in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under his or her care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice nursing or another health-care occupation suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license to practice nursing, practice as a certified midwife, or practice any other health-care occupation suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or aiding or knowingly permitting any person to violate any provision of this part 1 or applicable provisions of article 20 or 30
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or has aided or knowingly permitted any person to violate any provision of this part 1 or an applicable provision of article 20 or 30 of this title 12

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing nursing in a manner that fails to meet generally accepted standards for the practice of nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced nursing or as a certified midwife in a manner that fails to meet generally accepted standards for the practice of nursing or as a certified midwife, as applicable

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any order or rule of the board pertaining to nursing practice or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any order or rule of the board pertaining to nursing practice, practice as a certified midwife, or licensure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or negligently making incorrect entries or failing to make essential entries on patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has falsified or in a negligent manner made incorrect entries or failed to make essential entries on patient records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Excessive or habitual use or abuse of alcohol, habit-forming drugs, or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Excessively or habitually uses or abuses or has engaged in excessive or habitual use or abuse of alcohol, a habit-forming drug, a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a physical illness or behavioral health disorder affecting ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to: (I) Notify the board, as required by section 12-30-108 (1), of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral health, mental health, or substance use disorder that affects the person's ability to practice nursing or as a certified midwife with reasonable skill and safety to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the confidentiality of information or knowledge concerning any patient as prescribed by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated the confidentiality of information or knowledge as prescribed by law concerning any patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any conduct that would constitute a crime as defined in title 18 and that relates to employment as a nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any conduct that would constitute a crime as defined in title 18 and that relates to the person's employment as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating abuse of health insurance provisions or advertising to perform acts prohibited by those provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated abuse of health insurance pursuant to section 18-13-119

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful and repeated ordering or performance without clinical justification of demonstrably unnecessary services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful and repeated ordering or performance, without clinical justification, of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a fraudulent insurance act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed a fraudulent insurance act, as defined in section 10-1-128

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, distributing, or giving to oneself or a family member any controlled substance in schedule II
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has prescribed, distributed, or given to himself or herself or a family member any controlled substance as defined in part 2 of article 18 of title 18 or as contained in schedule II of 21 U.S.C. sec. 812

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing, injecting, or prescribing anabolic steroids for non-medical performance enhancement purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has dispensed, injected, or prescribed an anabolic steroid, as defined in section 18-18-102 (3), for the purpose of hormonal manipulation that is intended to increase muscle mass, strength, or weight without a medical necessity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by another state, territory, or country for conduct substantially similar to grounds for discipline under this part
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been disciplined by another state, territory, or country based upon an act or omission that is defined substantially the same as a ground for discipline pursuant to this subsection (1)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to respond in a materially factual and timely manner to a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully fails to respond in a materially factual and timely manner to a complaint issued pursuant to section 12-255-119 (3)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to accurately complete and submit the designated questionnaire upon renewal of a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to accurately complete and submit to the board the designated questionnaire upon renewal of a license pursuant to section 12-255-110 (3), 12-255-111.5 (4), 12-255-114 (3), or 12-255-115 (7)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as a licensed nurse or using protected nursing titles without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Represents oneself to an individual or to the general public by use of any word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that he or she is a licensed practical or professional nurse unless the person is actually licensed as a practical nurse or professional nurse, respectively

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing as a nurse or certified midwife during a period when the license has been suspended, revoked, or placed on inactive status
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife during a period when the person's license has been suspended, revoked, or placed on inactive status pursuant to section 12-255-122

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling or fraudulently obtaining or furnishing a license to practice as a nurse or certified midwife
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sells or fraudulently obtains or furnishes a license to practice as a nurse or certified midwife or aids or abets in such act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board within thirty days after a final conviction of a crime as defined in title 18
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the board, within thirty days after a final conviction, that the person has been convicted of a crime, as defined in title 18

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain professional liability insurance in accordance with section 12-255-113
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to maintain professional liability insurance in accordance with section 12-255-113

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during or within six months of the professional relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or within six months immediately following the termination of the person's professional relationship with the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board within thirty days after a final malpractice judgment or settlement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to notify the board, in writing and within thirty days after a judgment or settlement is entered, of a final judgment by a court of competent jurisdiction against the licensee for malpractice of nursing or as a certified midwife or a settlement by the licensee in response to charges or allegations of malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report within thirty days an adverse action taken against the person by another licensing agency, peer review body, or court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to report to the board, within thirty days after an adverse action, that an adverse action has been taken against the person by another licensing agency in another state or jurisdiction; a peer review body; a health-care institution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report within thirty days the surrender of a license or membership while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to report to the board, within thirty days, the surrender of a license or other authorization to practice nursing or as a certified midwife in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diverting or having diverted a controlled substance from the person's place of employment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is diverting or has diverted a controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), or any other drug having similar effects from the person's place of employment

insurance_required.quote: It is unlawful for any advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife engaged in an independent practice of professional nursing or as a certified midwife to practice within the state of Colorado unless the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife purchases and maintains or is covered by professional liability insurance in an amount not less than five hundred thousand dollars per claim

definition_quote.value: The practice of professional nursing means the delivery of independent and collaborative nursing care to individuals of all ages, families, groups, and communities, whether sick or well, in all settings. The functions include the initiation and performance of nursing care through health promotion, supportive or restorative care, disease prevention, diagnosis and treatment of human disease, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, and physical or mental condition using specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill involving the application of biological, physical, social, and behavioral science principles required for licensure as a professional nurse pursuant to section 12-255-110.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the delivery of independent and collaborative nursing care to individuals of all ages, families, groups, and communities, whether sick or well, in all settings.

value: Evaluating health status through collection and assessment of health data
Providing therapy and treatment supportive and restorative to life and well-being
Executing delegated medical functions and delegated patient care functions
Referring patients to medical or community agencies
Reviewing and monitoring therapy and treatment plans
methods_authorized.quote: The "practice of professional nursing" includes the performance of such services as: (I) Evaluating health status through the collection and assessment of health data; (II) Health teaching and health counseling; (III) Providing therapy and treatment that is supportive and restorative to life and well-being either directly to the patient or indirectly through consultation with, delegation to, supervision of, or teaching of others; (IV) Executing delegated medical functions and delegated patient care functions; (V) Referring to medical or community agencies those patients who need further evaluation or treatment; (VI) Reviewing and monitoring therapy and treatment plans.

drug_authority.value: Advanced practice registered nurses and certified midwives with prescriptive authority may prescribe controlled substances and prescription drugs within their scope of practice and population focus, subject to board requirements including graduate degree, national certification, professional liability insurance, and completion of a 750-hour prescribing mentorship.
drug_authority.quote: The board may authorize the following licensees to prescribe controlled substances or prescription drugs, as those terms are defined in section 12-280-103: (a) An advanced practice registered nurse who is listed on the advanced practice registry, who has a license in good standing without disciplinary sanctions issued pursuant to section 12-255-110, and who has fulfilled the requirements of this section

license_tiers.quote: A registered professional nurse who is included in the advanced practice registry has the right to use the title "advanced practice registered nurse" or, if authorized by the board, to use the title "certified nurse midwife", "clinical nurse specialist", "certified registered nurse anesthetist", or "nurse practitioner".

aprn_role_categories.quote: A registered professional nurse who is included in the advanced practice registry has the right to use the title "advanced practice registered nurse" or, if authorized by the board, to use the title "certified nurse midwife", "clinical nurse specialist", "certified registered nurse anesthetist", or "nurse practitioner".

value: Licensed health-care provider authorized to practice in this state
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Practice of practical nursing" means the performance, under the supervision of a licensed health-care provider authorized to practice in this state, of those services requiring the education, training, and experience

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse shall practice in accordance with the standards of the appropriate national professional nursing organization and have a safe mechanism for consultation or collaboration with a physician or, when appropriate, referral to a physician.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: Nothing in this part 1: (a) Prohibits any licensee from practicing practical or professional nursing or as a certified midwife independently for compensation upon a fee for services basis

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife who obtains prescriptive authority pursuant to this section shall be assigned a specific identifier by the state board of nursing.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: An APRN or certified midwife with prescriptive authority shall not prescribe more than a seven-day supply of an opioid to a patient who has not obtained an opioid prescription from that prescriber within the last twelve months, with exceptions for chronic pain, cancer, post-surgical pain, and palliative/hospice care.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A prescriber shall not prescribe more than a seven-day supply of an opioid to a patient who has not obtained an opioid prescription from that prescriber within the last twelve months and may exercise discretion to include a second fill for a seven-day supply.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Each prescriber licensed in this state who holds a current registration issued by the federal drug enforcement administration shall register and maintain a user account as specified in section 12-280-403.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The board shall maintain a registry of all certified nurse aides and a record of all final disciplinary action taken against persons under this article 255. The registry shall conform to all requirements of federal law and regulation.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: Prior to a certified nurse aide obtaining authority as a medication aide to administer medications, the certified nurse aide shall meet all applicable requirements as established by rules of the board.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Any licensed practical nurse, registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or certified midwife may delegate any task included in the nurse's or certified midwife's licensed scope of practice, subject to the requirements of this section. A licensed practical nurse, registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or certified midwife may delegate nursing or certified midwife tasks to licensed, certified, registered, or unlicensed or unregulated assistive personnel.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: An employer of a medication aide shall report conduct that constitutes grounds for discipline pursuant to this section to the board and any disciplinary action taken by the employer against a medication aide or the resignation of a medication aide in lieu of a disciplinary action resulting from the conduct.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: To facilitate the licensure of nurses under the "Enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact", part 38 of article 60 of title 24

multistate_license_option_available.quote: To facilitate the licensure of nurses under the "Enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact", part 38 of article 60 of title 24

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: except that the board has the discretion not to discipline the licensee if the licensee is participating in good faith in a program approved by the board designed to end the excessive or habitual use or abuse

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife must obtain seven hundred fifty hours of documented experience in a mutually structured prescribing mentorship either with a physician or with an advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife who has full prescriptive authority
